annotations.title: TIA — export objects to a VCI workspace

description: Writes 1 to 50 project objects {plc?, kind, name, format?} to the files of a VCI workspace. Only leaf objects are accepted: PLC blocks, PLC data types and tag tables; any other object is refused with 409 vci_not_leaf before VCI is called, nothing changed. An object that is not mapped yet is exported to a new file in the format you chose (action export); an already mapped object keeps its mapping's folder, file and format (a format you pass is not validated for it) and, when its status is not equal, is synchronized: its workspace file is OVERWRITTEN with the project content (action synchronize); when its status is equal it is skipped (action skip, reason already_equal) and nothing is written for it, because TIA refuses to synchronize an equal mapping. Everything is checked before the first write: 404 not_found (names the object), 409 vci_not_leaf, 409 vci_unsupported_object, 409 vci_path_too_long, 409 vci_status_unavailable, 409 vci_path_collision (details.collisions[].reason: batch, mapped_to_other_object, file_exists, or alias_unverifiable = an existing file's 8.3 short name could not be read, so a collision with its alias cannot be excluded; details file) and 400 batch_too_large. 409 vci_mapping_outside_workspace: a mapping outside the root is refused before any write (details plc, kind, name, directory, root); but when a NEW export reports a folder outside the root, the file WAS written there (details object, directory, root, done) and that answer is not 'nothing changed'. The batch is NOT a transaction: it stops at the first failure. 409 vci_batch_incomplete means done lists written and skipped objects, and the failed one may be partly written. 'Nothing was changed.' is promised only by refusals before the first write: any other failure (a first object's own error, 504 worker_restarted, a timeout, a lost connection) has an UNKNOWN or possibly partial outcome, so re-read with tia_vci_status before repeating. The export does not verify what it wrote: verify the result with tia_vci_status. Run it with dryRun:true first (Gd11): the same checks, listing what would be written WITHOUT changing anything. Requires a connected project and a workspace root (409 workspace_unconfigured); 409 vci_inventory_incomplete (the workspace inventory could not be read completely), nothing changed. Maps to POST /vci/workspaces/{workspace}/export {objects, dryRun?}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

objects.description: 1 to 50 distinct objects to export; more than 50 is 400 batch_too_large and nothing runs. A new object's target folder is created when it is missing, and a dryRun lists willCreateDirectory per object

format.description: file format VCI offers for an object that is NOT mapped yet (a mapped object keeps its mapping's format and this is not validated for it); leave it out unless the serve answers 400 bad_request with details.supportedFormats, then pick one of them

kind.description: block (OB, FB, FC or data block), type (a PLC data type) or tagtable (a PLC tag table): the only kinds VCI accepts

name.description: object name; the serve matches the exact name first, then ignoring case

plc.description: PLC software name from tia_plcs.name, not the device station name; omit for the first PLC of the project

workspace.description: workspace name, as listed by tia_vci_workspaces (the serve matches the exact name first, then ignoring case; a name that several workspace groups share is 409 workspace_ambiguous, details name and groups: never guessed, ask the human)

name: tia_vci_export
title: TIA — export objects to a VCI workspace
